cableway.name: Table Mountain Aerial Cableway
cableway.price_text: Return adult fare roughly ZAR 400–500 · check current price online
cableway.hours: Usually 08:30–19:00 in summer, shorter in winter · closed in strong wind
cableway.tip: Go at opening time. Clouds and wind close the cableway often, so check the status before you travel.
cableway.best: Early morning, clear day; avoid windy days

va-waterfront.name: V&A Waterfront
va-waterfront.price_text: Free to walk · shops and attractions priced separately
va-waterfront.tip: Busy but safe and easy. Use it as your base for boats, the aquarium and the Cape Wheel.

robben-island-prison.name: Robben Island Prison
robben-island-prison.price_text: Ferry and tour roughly ZAR 600–700 · book ahead
robben-island-prison.hours: Ferries usually mid-morning to early afternoon · weather dependent
robben-island-prison.tip: Tours are led by former political prisoners. Book days ahead and take seasickness tablets if the sea is rough.

boulders.name: Boulders Beach
boulders.price_text: Conservation fee roughly ZAR 150–200 for adults · check on the day
boulders.tip: See the penguins from the boardwalk. Keep a few metres away and never touch them.

kirstenbosch.name: Kirstenbosch National Botanical Garden
kirstenbosch.price_text: Adult entry roughly ZAR 200–250 · check current price
kirstenbosch.tip: Walk the Boomslang canopy walkway. Summer sunset concerts are a local favourite.

bo-kaap.name: Bo-Kaap
bo-kaap.tip: The bright houses are private homes. Ask before photographing people and doors.

table-mountain.name: Table Mountain
table-mountain.price_text: Free to hike · cableway charged separately
table-mountain.hours: Open land, daylight hours only for hiking
table-mountain.tip: Hike with a group or guide and check the weather. The mountain makes its own clouds fast.
table-mountain.best: Early morning; not in heat or wind

artscape.name: Artscape Theatre Centre
artscape.price_text: Ticket prices vary by show · check the programme
artscape.hours: Box office and shows in the evening · check schedule
artscape.tip: Check the programme for opera, ballet or local theatre. Book online before you go.

bobotie.name: Bobotie
bobotie.price_text: Main dish roughly ZAR 120–200 in a casual restaurant
bobotie.hours: Lunch and dinner at most Cape Malay and South African restaurants
bobotie.tip: A spiced mince bake with egg custard on top. Try it at a Cape Malay kitchen in Bo-Kaap.

camps-bay.name: Camps Bay Beach
camps-bay.price_text: Free · sunbeds and umbrellas for hire
camps-bay.tip: The water is cold. The beach is best for sunsets and walks, not long swims.

castle.name: Castle of Good Hope
castle.price_text: Adult entry roughly ZAR 50–100 · check on the day
castle.tip: The oldest surviving colonial building in South Africa. The key ceremony is worth timing your visit for.

companys-garden.name: Company's Garden
companys-garden.tip: A shady walk between museums. Watch your belongings and don't feed the squirrels.

district-six.name: District Six Museum
district-six.price_text: Adult entry roughly ZAR 50–80 · check on the day
district-six.tip: Small but powerful. Former residents often guide the floor and tell their own stories.

iziko-sa-museum.name: Iziko South African Museum
iziko-sa-museum.price_text: Adult entry roughly ZAR 50–100 · check on the day
iziko-sa-museum.tip: Good for families and rainy days. The natural history and rock art displays are the highlights.

lions-head.name: Lion's Head
lions-head.hours: Open land · hike in daylight · full moon hikes are popular
lions-head.tip: The sunrise hike is short but steep, with chains near the top. Go with others and carry water.
lions-head.best: Sunrise or full moon (with a group)

rhodes-memorial.name: Rhodes Memorial
rhodes-memorial.price_text: Free · small parking fee may apply
rhodes-memorial.tip: Big views over the city and Table Mountain. Go early and don't walk alone after dark.

robben-island.name: Robben Island
robben-island.price_text: Reached only by the official ferry tour · see Robben Island Prison
robben-island.tip: The island is visited as part of the prison tour. There is no independent access.

slave-lodge.name: Slave Lodge
slave-lodge.price_text: Adult entry roughly ZAR 50–80 · check on the day
slave-lodge.tip: One of the oldest buildings in the city. The slavery and early Cape history exhibits are sobering.

st-georges.name: St. George's Cathedral, Cape Town
st-georges.tip: Linked to Archbishop Desmond Tutu and the anti-apartheid movement. Step inside quietly.

table-bay.name: Table Bay
table-bay.price_text: Free to view from the shore
table-bay.tip: Best seen from the Waterfront or Sea Point promenade. Watch for seals and seabirds.

harbour-cruise.name: V&A Waterfront Harbour Cruise
harbour-cruise.price_text: Short harbour trips roughly ZAR 150–300 · check at the quay
harbour-cruise.tip: A short, easy boat ride. Book at the Waterfront and take a jacket for the wind.

zeitz-mocaa.name: Zeitz MOCAA
zeitz-mocaa.price_text: Adult entry roughly ZAR 200–250 · check current price
zeitz-mocaa.hours: Usually Thu–Sun 10:00–18:00 · check on the day
zeitz-mocaa.tip: Contemporary African art in a converted grain silo. The carved atrium is worth the ticket alone.

old-biscuit-mill.name: Old Biscuit Mill market (Saturday)
old-biscuit-mill.price_text: Free entry · food roughly ZAR 60–150 a plate
old-biscuit-mill.hours: Saturday market usually 09:00–14:00 · check on the day
old-biscuit-mill.tip: Come hungry and early. It gets crowded by late morning.

signal-hill.name: Signal Hill viewpoint
signal-hill.tip: Watch the sunset over the Atlantic. Take a jacket and don't leave valuables in the car.

sea-point-promenade.name: Sea Point Promenade walk
sea-point-promenade.hours: Always open · busy and safer in daylight
sea-point-promenade.tip: A flat seaside walk with ocean views. Good for a morning run or a sunset stroll.

cape-point-drive.name: Cape Peninsula day drive
cape-point-drive.price_text: Self-drive or tour roughly ZAR 800–1500 per person · check inclusions
cape-point-drive.tip: Chapman's Peak Drive, Cape Point and Boulders in one day. Book a tour or hire a car.
cape-point-drive.best: Full day, start early, clear weather

woodstock-walk.name: Woodstock street-art walk
woodstock-walk.price_text: Self-guided free · guided tours roughly ZAR 300–500
woodstock-walk.tip: Street art, cafes and old factories. Walk in a group and keep phones out of sight.
